2.name: No Good Deed
2.overview: A mysterious ally leads Lara to a technological utopia, where a brilliant philanthropist offers her a challenge that could reshape her legacy forever.

2.name: Festa de Iemanja
2.overview: Amid a vibrant celebration in Brazil, Lara goes head-to-head with a ruthless rival to prevent a powerful artifact from falling into sinister hands.

2.name: Crossroads
2.overview: In the heart of New Orleans' voodoo culture, Lara's quest for a sacred mask plunges her into a deep-sea adventure where myth meets mortal peril.

2.name: Slán Abhaile
2.overview: Deep within a frozen fortress, a long-awaited reunion sparks a showdown between Lara and Mila that threatens to shatter more than just ice.

2.name: Croft's 6
2.overview: An undercover mission at a lavish gala strands Lara in enemy territory, forcing her to fight her way out before a high-security lockdown seals her doom.

2.name: "The One Who Kills and Is Thanked for It"
2.overview: Lara and Sam dive into the waters off the Cuban coast to recover a lost Orisha mask, setting the stage for a reckoning neither side can afford to lose.

2.name: The Breaking of the Land
2.overview: As the world spirals into chaos, Lara and Eshu explore a lost African city, hoping the truth of his past holds the key to stopping what's coming next.

2.name: The Bringer of Death
2.overview: With the final battle at hand, Lara rallies a resistance for an epic face-off as ancient forces awaken and humanity's fate teeters on the edge of ruin.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Lara Croft must return home when a dangerous and powerful Chinese artifact is stolen from Croft Manor by a thief with an uncanny personal connection. Her daring pursuit will take her on an adventure around the world and to the depths of forgotten tombs, where she will be forced to confront her true self and decide just what kind of hero she wants to become.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: When adventurer Lara Croft discovers a trail of stolen African Orisha masks, she joins forces with her best friend Sam to retrieve the precious artifacts. Lara's thrilling new adventure takes her around the globe as she delves deeper into the hidden secrets of Orisha history, dodging the machinations of a dangerous and enigmatic billionaire who wants the masks for herself, while discovering these relics contain dark secrets and a power that defies logic. Power that may, in fact, be divine.
